name: NAD+
description: Coenzyme found in every living cell (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide), made by the body from vitamin B3

note.lead: Not tested against aging in people.
note.text: No study has shown that injected or nasal NAD+ slows aging in people. The two controlled trials were in heart disease.

bullets: **Coenzyme** that enzymes use to move electrons in energy metabolism
**Used up** as a raw material by other enzymes
Most NAD+ biology comes from **cell and animal** research
**In people,** effects of injected or nasal NAD+ are not established
2 randomized trials in China, heart disease, not aging
IV pilot in 11 men; chart review of 14
No human study of nasal NAD+

practical.routes: IV infusion; no human study of nasal spray
practical.pharmacokinetics: IV: cleared from blood quickly for the first 2 hours (pilot)
practical.monitored: NAD+ in blood and urine, liver tests, heart pumping (LVEF)
practical.sport: Not on the 2026 list; IV over 100 mL per 12 h prohibited (M2.2)

regulatory.text: Food-grade NAD+ not for sterile IV use (Oct 2024)

references: Front Aging Neurosci, IV NAD+ infusion pilot in healthy men, Sep 2019
FDA, 503A bulk drug substance categories, May 2026
